This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority. After terminal consumption, a fresh unused successor must be supplied through the then-current canonical reviewed path if main advances again before another normal Bureau pickup.
